summary: AI/crypto market jitters dominate today — Anthropic's stock cracked below its $83 IPO price for the first time and dragged crypto back down with it — while phone coverage leans on a fresh three-way Motorola comparison plus a cluster of practical Galaxy/Android Auto bug fixes and Black Friday-season deal angles. Phone's share is lighter than the usual 70% target because today's phone wires were mostly thin spec-leak filler; the net was widened to bugs, deals and one new comparison rather than forcing weak picks.
